findings.title: Emergency alert service bypasses model router

evidence.observation: Direct API calls to Gemini and Mistral using GEMINI_API_KEY and MISTRAL_API_KEY instead of routing requests through the model router

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency alert generation to use the model router task routing endpoints instead of direct SDK/API calls

findings.expected_benefit: Centralised model routing, fallback management, load visibility, and consistent latency tracking across all intelligence tasks

findings.title: Model router call log file is missing

evidence.observation: Configured log_file is reported missing (call_log_exists: false) despite active router operations and recorded failed requests

proposed_action.description: Ensure the directory for call_log.jsonl exists and that the router service has write permissions to create and append call logs

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into model call metrics, failure diagnostics, token consumption, and routing auditability
